sentences.text: No: for the pre-payment charge rules in paragraph 261(1) and 261(2), the source of funds used for pre-payment does not matter, and there is no minimum lock-in period.

Those directions apply to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, and paragraph 261(4) says dual or special rate loans depend on whether the loan is floating rate at the time of pre-payment.
For cases other than those covered by paragraph 261(1) and (2), any pre-payment charges are governed by the UCB’s approved policy.
I did not search for any bank-specific approved policy text, so I cannot say whether that policy adds any source-of-funds condition outside paragraph 261(1) and (2).
